symptom: `mxcli test tests --list` prints `Found 0 test(s)` when the suites live in `tests/<Module>/*.test.mdl`, while `mxcli test tests/Sales --list` finds them
cause: `testrunner.ParseTestDir` listed the directory with `os.ReadDir` and `continue`d on every sub-directory, so only test files directly inside the named folder were ever read
insight: **Discovery is a recursive walk now, and hidden folders below the root are skipped** (`.git`, `.mxcli`; the root itself is always read, so `mxcli test .` works). `emptySuiteError` must use the same walk or its `were not read` hint goes blind to exactly the nested layout the fix enables. `filepath.WalkDir` does not follow a root that is a symlink, so `walkTestTree` resolves it first (`os.ReadDir` used to follow it). Layout test: `parser_dir_test.go`; the `FilesRead` counter and the per-file `FileErrors` isolation are unchanged and the walk keeps going past a bad file. No other discovery rule (node_modules etc.) exists in the test runner, so none was added.
